sources.title: Cerebras registration statement on Form S-1, April 17, 2026
Cerebras final prospectus (Form 424B4) for its initial public offering, dated May 13, 2026
Cerebras Form 8-K, May 15, 2026 (completion of the initial public offering)

event.title: Cerebras initial public offering
event.summary: Cerebras sold Class A shares in its initial public offering on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, including the underwriters' full option to buy more shares. Gross proceeds were $6.4 billion.

amounts.label: Gross proceeds
amounts.quote: The gross proceeds to the Company from the initial public offering were $6.4 billion, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by the Company.

amounts.label: Offering price per Class A share
amounts.quote: On May 15, 2026, the Company completed its initial public offering of an aggregate of 34,500,000 shares of Class A Common Stock at a price to the public of $185.00 per share, which includes the exercise in full by the underwriters of their option to purchase from the Company an additional 4,500,000 shares of Class A Common Stock.

quantities.label: Class A shares sold, including the underwriters' option
quantities.quote: On May 15, 2026, the Company completed its initial public offering of an aggregate of 34,500,000 shares of Class A Common Stock at a price to the public of $185.00 per share, which includes the exercise in full by the underwriters of their option to purchase from the Company an additional 4,500,000 shares of Class A Common Stock.

facts.label: Listing
facts.text: Class A shares listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol CBRS.
facts.quote: We have been approved to list our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol "CBRS," and this offering is contingent upon the listing of our Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market.

facts.label: Underwriters
facts.text: Morgan Stanley, Citigroup and Barclays acted as representatives of the underwriters.
facts.quote: the underwriters named below, for whom Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, Citigroup Global Markets Inc., and Barclays Capital Inc. are acting as representatives

facts.label: Estimated net proceeds
facts.text: The prospectus estimated net proceeds of about $5,408.5 million, or $6,221.4 million with the option exercised in full.
facts.quote: We estimate that we will receive net proceeds from this offering of approximately $5,408.5 million (or $6,221.4 million if the underwriters exercise their over-allotment option in full), based upon the initial public offering price of $185.00 per share of Class A common stock, and after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us.
